en.headline: Family Style Food Fest brings chef-led outdoor event to West Kowloon this weekend
en.dek: The two-day event at the Art Park Great Lawn on 28 and 29 November features Eddie Huang, Jason Oh and David Lai alongside food stalls, music and limited Family Table seats.
body: Family Style Food Fest opens this Saturday and Sunday at the Great Lawn of the West Kowloon Art Park, presented as a standalone outdoor event by ComplexCon.

The organisers said the programme places chefs at the centre, with invited guests including Eddie Huang making his first Hong Kong appearance, Netflix Black & White Chef participant Jason Oh bringing street flavours from his TAK restaurant, and Michelin-starred chef David Lai of Paragon.

In addition to a market of food and drink stalls and music programming, the event includes a limited Family Table experience where selected chefs serve a shared meal. Organisers said a small number of seats are available through a name-your-price mechanism, with some reserved for HSBC Visa Signature cardholders.

Tickets went on general sale earlier this month via the ComplexCon Asia app, Klook and Trip.com. The organisers describe the event as combining chef-led dining, street-food culture and live music on the harbourfront lawn.

zh.headline: Family Style Food Fest本周末西九藝術公園大草坪舉行
zh.dek: 由 ComplexCon主辦的兩日活動於 11月 28及 29日舉行，邀請 Eddie Huang、Jason Oh及黎國基等主廚，設美食攤檔、音樂及限量 Family Table席位。
body: Family Style Food Fest本周六及周日在西九文化區藝術公園大草坪舉行，由 ComplexCon以獨立戶外盛事形式主辦。
主辦方表示，活動以主廚為核心，特邀嘉賓包括首次來港的 Eddie Huang、Netflix《黑白大廚》參賽者 Jason Oh帶來其 TAK餐廳街頭風味，以及米芝蓮一星主廚黎國基。
除美食飲品攤檔及音樂節目外，活動設限量 Family Table體驗，由選定主廚呈獻共饗餐點。主辦方指部分席位透過「Name Your Price」競投，另有滙豐 Visa Signature持卡人專屬名額。
門票已於本月較早時透過 ComplexCon Asia應用程式、Klook及 Trip.com公開發售。主辦方形容活動結合主廚主導餐飲、街頭飲食文化及現場音樂。
